data.scenario:
In the intro of Remothering Tape, the protagonist is lounging in the living room when his mother, {character("mother")}, returns from a shopping trip. She excitedly presents a VHS tape she found called The Remothering Tape, claiming it will help them reconnect as mother and son. Despite his reluctance, the protagonist agrees to watch it with her.

As the video starts, it introduces a calm, idealized mother-son duo as the presenters, promising to help parents and children bond. However, things take an unsettling turn when a hypnotic spiral begins to appear on the screen. His mother’s eyes widen, her expression shifts to something subtly hungry, and she becomes deeply fixated on the video and following the instructions.
